craft_notes: Sthāyin: seeing and worshipping. Rows: made then offered. Read aloud: beholding.

lines: Thus all-pure mind-and-body made the Highest,
and outside, burnt offerings set in blossoms,
as possible each work and worship.
l4.sanskrit_cite: evam anyonyamelakayogena parameśvarībhūtaṃ prāṇadehabuddhyādi bhāvayitvā bahir antaḥ puṣpadhūpatarpaṇādyair yathāsambhavaṃ pūjayet
